description: Check a verification code submitted by a user, by the phone or email it went to. Returns {verified, status, channel, charged}. Billed only when verified is true.

email.description: The address the code was emailed to. After a fallback, check by `email`: the code proves the address, not the phone, and a check by `phone` answers 409 `invalid_state`.

phone.description: The number the code was texted to. Send this or `email`.

name: check_verification
title: Check verification
